opportunities.title: The Password Manager You Trust Just Got Popped—Twice: 1Password and pCloud Breached in the Same Week
opportunities.why_now: Two major password managers (1Password's source code/customer data, pCloud's login/email exposure) were confirmed breached within days of each other, hitting the core promise of the product category.
opportunities.angle: Combo breach digest: what was actually taken, what users should rotate now, and why 'zero trust your password manager' is the new baseline advice

opportunities.title: SAP Confirms Breach, Source Code Allegedly Stolen — What That Means for Every Enterprise Running It
opportunities.why_now: SAP just confirmed a cyberattack with source code reportedly compromised, a supply-chain-grade event given how many Fortune 500 backends run on SAP.
opportunities.angle: Explainer on downstream risk: source code theft as a precursor to targeted exploit development, plus a patch-cadence checklist for SAP shops

opportunities.title: FIFA Got Hacked Weeks Before a Global Tournament Cycle — Here's What 'Personal and Business Information' Really Means
opportunities.why_now: FIFA disclosed a breach accessing personal and business data, a high-profile target with massive fan/sponsor data exposure potential.
opportunities.angle: News hook + speculative breakdown of attacker motive (fraud vs. espionage vs. ransomware) and who's actually exposed

opportunities.title: Patch Tuesday Isn't Fast Enough: Drupal and Cacti Zero-Days Are Already Being Exploited in the Wild
opportunities.why_now: Drupal's critical site-takeover flaw and an unpatched Cacti RCE (exploitable in just 4 HTTP requests) are both under active attack right now, a textbook patch-cadence emergency.
opportunities.angle: Urgent patch-now digest format with CVE details, exploit timelines, and mitigation steps for sysadmins

opportunities.title: Switzerland Just Confirmed AI-Assisted Hackers Breached Its Critical Infrastructure — The Threat Model Everyone Predicted Is Here
opportunities.why_now: Switzerland officially confirmed AI-assisted attacks breached critical infrastructure operators, a concrete, government-confirmed instance of the AI-threat-actor trend also seen in Microsoft's ARTEX reporting and Mitel's suspected AI-assisted zero-day exploitation.
opportunities.angle: Trend roundup tying three separate AI-assisted attack stories into one 'this is no longer theoretical' thesis piece
